{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness 插件：原生上传管线上的文件夹按钮 + read_document 文档解析（PDF/DOCX/XLSX）。The folder button on the native upload pipeline, plus the read_document parser.","id":"gh:1333699356","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-files","slug":"taxueseek/dsh-files","topics":["deepseek-harness","documents","dsh-plugin","file-upload","pdf","read-document"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness 插件：原生上传管线上的文件夹按钮 + read_document 文档解析（PDF/DOCX/XLSX）。The folder button on the nativ"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"e upload pipeline, plus the read_document parser."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"# dsh-files"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## In one line"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Let the AI actually read the documents you upload — and let your files come back out."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What changed in this release"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **SDK aligned with the host at 0.2.0-rc.2**: fixes "the plugin button is missing and native upload"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" is dead in the desktop App" — the plugin used to be built against the old SDK, colliding with the h"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"ost's newer bundled components in the client module graph
- **Errors now speak plainly**: a failure "},{"id":"p7s4","text":"used to hand you a cold error code; now it tells you **what to change next**. Reach the server over "},{"id":"p7s5","text":"your LAN and the attachment routes answer 403 — the response prints the exact `trustedHosts` line to"},{"id":"p7s6","text":" add, ready to copy
- **LAN / domain deployments are documented now**: that section used to be blank"},{"id":"p7s7","text":", leaving you to guess
- **The division of work with the host is written down**: what the host alrea"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"dy does (upload, images, document preview) versus what remains unique to this plugin — so the wheel "},{"id":"p7s9","text":"images, document preview) versus what remains unique to this plugin — so the wheel is not reinvented"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Here is a file's **four-stage session lifecycle**, one official gap filled per stage:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **Ingest**: the **folder button next to the native paperclip** (plus a same-named entry in the off"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"icial "+" command menu) — the browser flattens the directory (Office lock files, `.DS_Store`, `.env`"},{"id":"p9s3","text":" and other system/hidden files are filtered), and every file enters the official native attachment p"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"ipeline
- **Read**: the **`read_document` tool** — structured text extraction for binary documents ("},{"id":"p9s5","text":"PDF / DOC / DOCX / PPTX / XLSX) plus enhanced text reading (encoding fallback, paging, page_range sl"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"icing, Markdown tables, sheet-level access)
- **Manage**: the **`attachment_list` / `export_attachme"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"nt` tools** plus **in-panel delete** — make the attachment store visible to the model (name/size/sha"},{"id":"p9s8","text":") and copy a file into the workspace for read/edit/bash to work on; the panel also removes a single "},{"id":"p9s9","text":"attachment (the store is no longer append-only)
- **Fetch back**: the **attachment dock** (one offic"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"ial pill below the composer card) plus download/export routes and an `@` attachment source — the sto"},{"id":"p9s11","text":"re becomes visible to users and files can be pulled into the browser (the right path for remote/LAN "},{"id":"p9s12","text":"deployments); the `@` menu inserts the official handle line, identical to what the model saw at uplo"},{"id":"p9s13","text":"ployments); the `@` menu inserts the official handle line, identical to what the model saw at upload"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Why it exists"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Native upload in harness 0.1.3 stores files as byte objects and hands the model one handle line (nam"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"e, size, digest, read-only path) to read with **file tools** — but the built-in read tool rejects bi"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"nary content with `FS_NOT_TEXT`. Structured text extraction for PDF / DOC / DOCX / XLSX, plus attach"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"ment-store listing and export (the official GC is on the roadmap and the store is invisible to the m"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"odel today), are the gaps the official stack leaves open; this plugin fills them."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Capabilities"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- **Content sniffing**: PDF header / OLE Compound File (Word 97-2003) / ZIP central-directory member"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"s / UTF-8 (fatal) / UTF-16 BOM / GB18030 — decided from bytes, never from extensions; disguised file"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"s (an exe renamed .pdf) are rejected. The format hint is only a last resort when bytes are fully unk"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"nown
- **PPTX presentations (0.7.0)**: pure JS / zero native dependency parser for PresentationML, e"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"xtracting slides in sequence with body paragraphs, shapes, and tables (formatted as Markdown tables)"},{"id":"p14s6","text":", with `page_range` support
- **Page slicing (`page_range`)**: PDF and PPTX support targeted extract"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"ion of specific pages/slides (e.g. `"1-3, 5"`), saving significant context budget on large documents"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"
- **Markdown structured output (`output_format`)**: DOCX and XLSX intelligently output structured M"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"arkdown headings and tables (default), or can be toggled to plain unformatted `text`
- **Legacy .doc"},{"id":"p14s10","text":"**: macOS uses the system `textutil` (most complete body and date lines in the gold-standard compari"},{"id":"p14s11","text":"son), other platforms fall back to pure-JS `word-extractor`
- **Encoding chain**: UTF-16 BOM → UTF-8"},{"id":"p14s12","text":" (fatal, NUL rejected) → GB18030 (fatal) → UTF-16 without BOM (high-confidence guard); GBK Chinese a"},{"id":"p14s13","text":"nd BOM-less UTF-16 both read
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| dsh-files | Harness | Notes |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| 0.7.0 | **0.2.2-rc.1 (current line — CLI and Desktop App)** | Adds pure-JS PPTX presentation parsi"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ng, `page_range` slicing, and Markdown structured outputs; passes `plugin-fast-adapt` standards revi"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ew with a 100/100 score; peerDependencies explicitly cover `^0.2.2-0`; 222/222 tests pass green. |
|"},{"id":"p17s4","text":" 0.6.2 | 0.2.1-rc.3 | SDK devDependencies aligned to `0.2.1-rc.3` (cordis 4.0.5, schemastery 3.18.5)"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"; peer ranges widened to cover the host `0.2.1` line explicitly — by the semver prerelease tuple rul"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"e `^0.2.0-rc.1` does not match `0.2.1-rc.x`. No API drift: typecheck + 214 tests + the #17 lifecycle"},{"id":"p17s7","text":" probe re-run green on rc.3 host components. |
| 0.6.1 | 0.2.1-rc.2 | Attachment-route lifecycle fix"},{"id":"p17s8","text":" (#17: route disposers bound to the injection fiber), lazy parser loading (~200 ms off every host st"},{"id":"p17s9","text":"art) and `attachment_list` name filter; same surfaces as 0.6.0. Range unchanged — `^0.2.1-alpha.3` a"},{"id":"p17s10","text":"lready covers `rc.2` (verified with semver). |
| 0.6.0 | 0.2.1-alpha.3 | Attachment delete route + s"},{"id":"p17s11","text":"hard-scan cache + host-component peer relocation (PR #14); same surfaces as 0.5.x, no new seat depen"},{"id":"p17s12","text":"dencies. |
| 0.5.6 | 0.2.0-rc.2 (measured) | Same SDK alignment as 0.5.5; `package.json` now carries"},{"id":"p17s13","text":" machine-readable metadata: `repository`, `engines` (Node ≥ 20), and `dsh.compatibility` (`dshReleas"},{"id":"p17s14","text":"es` / `dshOperations`). |
| 0.5.5 | 0.2.0-rc.2 (measured) | SDK aligned with the host `0.2.0-rc.2` ("},{"id":"p17s15","text":"`dsh-fs` / `dsh-tools` / `dsh-client-ui-primitives` all at the host version), so client components r"},{"id":"p17s16","text":"esolve without a version ambiguity. |
| 0.5.3–0.5.4 | 0.1.7-alpha.1 | SDK pinned at `0.1.7-alpha.1`;"},{"id":"p17s17","text":" on a `0.2.0-rc.2` host the client icons may fail to resolve (see below). |
| 0.5.x | ≥ 0.1.3-alpha."},{"id":"p17s18","text":"1 | Older SDK pins (`0.1.0-rc.x`); attachment dock and `@` source predate the host's `conversation.c"},{"id":"p17s19","text":"omposer.dock` slot. |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Requires Node.js ≥ 20 (the floor the plugin is developed and tested on; the harness CLI itself runs "},{"id":"p18s2","text":"on the user's Node)."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Security"}],"truncated":true}
